_comment: Wan 2.1 VACE depth-guided video via the WanVideoWrapper stack. Geometry comes from a rendered depth SEQUENCE (Blender blockout), appearance from the text prompt — the split validated 2026-07-28 (docs/GUIDED-GENERATION.md §10). Substitute {prompt} {negative_prompt} {seed} {frames} {width} {height} through the runner's standard tokens and {depth_dir} through generate_from_workflow(substitutions={'depth_dir': ...}).
_constraints: CORE NODES CANNOT RUN THIS. Both core paths were falsified 2026-07-28: ControlNetLoader rejects the Wan depth controlnet ('not a valid controlnet model') and UNETLoader rejects the VACE module ('could not detect model type') — the weights are wrapper-format and the wrapper's own VACEPATH / WANVIDEOCONTROLNET types exist for exactly that reason. Do not 'simplify' this back onto KSampler. Resolution: 832x480 is the 1.3B model's native band; 1024x576 (sequence length 29952) hard-crashed ComfyUI with no Python traceback on a 16GB card. Frames on the 4n+1 grid. The T5 must NOT be an fp8-*scaled* checkpoint — LoadWanVideoT5TextEncoder rejects those explicitly.
_depth_contract: {depth_dir} is an absolute path to a directory of LOSSLESS PNGs, one per frame, matching {frames}/{width}/{height}. Render it with scripts/blockout_depth_probe.py, which uses a FIXED near/far — never a per-frame normalize, or the control signal breathes and the restyle flickers. Do not route the sequence through an h264 intermediate; chroma subsampling bands the depth ramp.

inputs.negative_prompt: {negative_prompt}, blurry, low quality, distorted, watermark, text, static image, deformed
